overview: The Indian Ceramic Technology Cluster Scheme is a Central Sector Scheme under the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) aimed at developing plug-and-play industrial parks for the glass and ceramics sector. It falls under the broader Bharat Audyogik Vikas Yojana (BHAVYA) initiative, which aims to develop 100 plug-and-play industrial parks across the country with a financial outlay of ₹33,660 crores over six years (FY 2026-27 to 2031-32). The scheme focuses on providing infrastructure and support to MSMEs and entrepreneurs in the glass and ceramics sector through plug-and-play industrial parks.
objectives: Develop 100 plug-and-play industrial parks across the country for the glass and ceramics sector
Provide plug-and-play infrastructure to support industrial development
Support MSMEs and entrepreneurs in the glass and ceramics sector
Promote industrial development through Central Sector Scheme funding
Enhance ease of doing business in the glass and ceramics sector
Foster innovation and entrepreneurship in ceramics and glass manufacturing
eligibility: The scheme is implemented under the Bharat Audyogik Vikas Yojana (BHAVYA), a Central Sector Scheme with a financial outlay of ₹33,660 crores for developing 100 plug-and-play industrial parks across the country from FY 2026-27 to 2031-32. The scheme targets MSMEs, entrepreneurs, and startups in the glass and ceramics sector for setting up units in plug-and-play industrial parks.
benefits: The scheme provides plug-and-play industrial park infrastructure for the glass and ceramics sector, including developed plots with basic infrastructure, enabling MSMEs and entrepreneurs to set up units with minimal setup time. Benefits include access to developed industrial plots, common facilities, and support for industrial development under the BHAVYA scheme.
financial_support: The Bharat Audyogik Vikas Yojana (BHAVYA) has a total financial outlay of ₹33,660 crores for developing 100 plug-and-play industrial parks across the country from FY 2026-27 to 2031-32. Financial support is provided as a Central Sector Scheme for infrastructure development in plug-and-play industrial parks.
application_process: 1. Visit the BHAVYA portal for accepting applications under the scheme. 2. Access the General and Operational Guidelines of BHAVYA Scheme for 100 New Plug-and-Play Industrial Parks in the Country. 3. Submit application through the BHAVYA portal for acceptance under the scheme. 4. Await application processing and approval as per scheme guidelines.
implementing_agency: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry
